channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: Vans' Backless Cowhide Skate Mule Is Now a Moo-le
item.description: Vans' cowhide OTW LX Mule Style 17 shoe is a hybrid slip-on with some major farm house energy.

item.title: These Gorgeous Leather Shoes Are Actually Kiko Kostadinov's First Crocs Collab (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Kiko Kostadinov's debut Crocs collaboration yields gorgeous leather hiking shoes, a rugged new look for a brand better known for rubber clogs.

item.title: Nike's Delicious Buckled Leather Sneaker Ain't For the Gluten Intolerant
item.description: The Nike ACG Phassad Wheat ticks boxes in both style and performance, making it a perfect companion to see out the rest of winter.

item.title: Vans' All-Blue Skate Shoe Is a Yves Klein Shredder
item.description: The Vans x 2 Riser Pads Old Skool is one of the most head-turning drops of recent memory, decked in a tonal blue outfit.

item.title: Nike's Ultra-Clean Stamped Suede AF1 Hides a Hippie Secret
item.description: The Nike Air Force One Low Suede ‘Paisley/Grey Fog/Metallic Silver’ sticks to what the silhouette does best, but this time with some added flavor.

item.title: There's a Lovely Little Bit of Old Céline In New CELINE (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: CELINE's Fall/Winter 2026 collection is beautifully realized by creative director Michael Rider as real luxury for real people, echoing Phoebe Philo's Céline.

item.title: Nike's Ghostly Zipped-Up Air Max 95 Is Scary Good
item.description: Nike's milk-toned Big Bubble Air Max 95 sneaker is a frothy iteration of the Swoosh's best sneaker to date.
